mapper.insert: insert into employee_work_schedule( work_schedule_no, contract_no, scheduled_work_date, scheduled_clock_in, scheduled_clock_out, scheduled_day_type, actual_work_hours, actual_overtime_hours, actual_night_hours, actual_holiday_hours ) values( #{workScheduleNo}, #{contractNo}, #{scheduledWorkDate}, #{scheduledClockIn}, #{scheduledClockOut}, #{scheduledDayType}, 0, 0, 0, 0 )
mapper.update:
update employee_work_schedule
scheduled_work_date = #{scheduledWorkDate},
scheduled_day_type = #{scheduledDayType}, scheduled_clock_in = null, scheduled_clock_out = null,
scheduled_clock_in = #{scheduledClockIn},
scheduled_clock_out = #{scheduledClockOut},
scheduled_day_type = #{scheduledDayType},
actual_work_hours = #{actualWorkHours},
actual_overtime_hours = #{actualOvertimeHours},
actual_night_hours = #{actualNightHours},
actual_holiday_hours = #{actualHolidayHours},
where work_schedule_no = #{workScheduleNo}
mapper.select:
select S.work_schedule_no, S.contract_no, S.scheduled_work_date, S.scheduled_clock_in, S.scheduled_clock_out, S.scheduled_day_type, S.actual_work_hours, S.actual_overtime_hours, S.actual_night_hours, S.actual_holiday_hours
from employee_work_schedule S
left join employee_attendance A on A.contract_no = S.contract_no and A.work_date = S.scheduled_work_date
where S.scheduled_day_type = 'workday'
and S.scheduled_clock_out is not null
and S.scheduled_clock_out < #{now}
and A.emp_attendance_no is null
order by S.scheduled_work_date asc
